proposed_from.topic: Sharp aggregate-ATT regions under latent-transition type mergers. In the compact binary four-period at-most-two-type Ahn–Kasahara model, with the pre-treatment transition shared across treatment arms within type and all primitive probabilities in [η,1−η] for fixed rational 0<η<0.15, define the global transition-alignment fiber of the full observed path PMF. Prove a branch-complete 16-chart full-path factorization covering terminal collisions, rank failures, all probability-box faces, and every cross-arm alignment; derive explicit observable vanishing/sign conditions necessary and sufficient for aggregate ATT at dates 3 and 4 to be point identified; otherwise compute the attained sharp region, allowing disconnected finite unions of intervals, by a terminating branch-aware exact algorithm. Give uniformly honest confidence regions for the entire identified set and endpoint/Hausdorff consistency under explicit branch-continuity conditions. Consumer: the public ak package and its Dodd–Frank, Norwegian patenting, and ADA analyses, whose reported ATT sign and bootstrap uncertainty change at merger fibers. PRESOLVE EVIDENCE REQUIRING VERIFICATION: Full path tensors, not pair moments, are necessary. Sixteen terminal-collision charts yield explicit splitting formulas, eight rank-one constraints, and four cross-arm alignment equations. A positive law has exactly two attainable ATT values. For the supplied merger law, every unequal-ATT representation has common prehistory and falls into four control cases; convexity fixes extremizing arm weights, reducing full endpoints to four eight-inequality polygon problems. At η=1/10, exact rational arithmetic gives I3=[−8867/29480,7517/29480] and I4=[−8611/29480,7773/29480], both crossing zero; endpoint PMFs and an η=7/50 branch switch were checked. Pair-moment insufficiency, terminal collisions, coincident components, disconnected regions, and fixed-coverage Hausdorff failure were tested; no exact literature collision was found. UNRESOLVED BOTTLENECK: Derive model-specific observable vanishing/sign tests that are necessary and sufficient for all sixteen feasible chart images to coincide at one ATT value, including rank deficiencies, alignments, and box contacts, without substituting unrestricted multivariate quantifier elimination. EARLY KILL TEST: Independently verify the sixteen-chart reconstruction, then completely classify the case with distinct treated terminal rows and exactly one collided control terminal row. An omitted legal branch or classification requiring only unrestricted generic QE triggers a pivot before expanding the atlas. proposed_from.novelty_justification: The closest econometric comparator is Ahn--Kasahara: Proposition 4 identifies the parameter vector under RSM, M, and ID, while Proposition 5 and Corollary 1 identify LTATT and aggregate ATT under the stated TI--LT regular conditions. Those results inform this independently compactified one-collision analysis but are not theorem-level targets. Higgins and Jochmans's Theorem 1 is the closest four-observation finite Markov-mixture identification theorem: under Assumptions 1--3 it recovers the initial distributions, transition kernels, and type probabilities up to a common permutation, but it does not classify the coupled-arm singular collision fiber or aggregate ATT. Geiger and Meek's Theorems 1--2 in Section 2 and applications in Sections 3.2--3.4 provide the exact bridge from polynomial latent-variable models to implicit constraints, identification, bounds, and real quantifier elimination; they do not supply the model-specific two-arm branch system or causal output grammar. Collins-style real quantifier elimination remains the closest exact algorithmic comparator. The advance is not a new generic CAD complexity bound. It is a proved causal reduction from the forty lifted prefix-and-terminal coordinates to the displayed ten-variable systems, a complete inventory of thirty-two \(k_0\)-orientation-alignment branches, an observable sign certificate \(\mathscr L_{k_0,\sigma}\), and exact branch-labeled ATT output with Thom-encoded endpoints and reconstructed witnesses. No inclusion between the compact class and Ahn--Kasahara's published class is asserted.

seed_details.anchor_location: The Introduction, Proposition P-2, Proposition P-1, and the proof around equations (A-z), (D-z), and (L-star) were read in the arXiv source. Proposition P-2 obtains component recovery from nonsingular matrix products and distinct eigenvalues; the proof then aligns permutations before forming aggregate ATT. The current source has no labeled conclusion, so its final application and inference sections were also checked.
seed_details.question: Can the full binary four-period ATT fiber be covered by sixteen explicit terminal-collision charts, and can observable polynomial vanishing and sign tests characterize exactly when both aggregate ATT coordinates are constant on their union?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the inversion of the observable matrix product and its distinct-eigenvalue eigendecomposition by terminal splitting of the full path tensor, followed by direct rank-one and cross-arm alignment equations on every collision pattern.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches combining latent-transition ATT, merger fiber, terminal collision, rank failure, and observable singleton conditions found regular identification results and algebraic HMM membership tests, but no cross-arm causal functional criterion.

seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Ahn--Kasahara because their Proposition P-2 already identifies the latent mixture up to labels.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their proof explicitly uses nonsingular reconstruction matrices, distinct eigenvalues, and invertible alignment matrices; the proposed theorem begins where those steps are undefined and asks for constancy of ATT rather than recovery of every latent parameter.

seed_details.anchor_location: The Introduction, polynomial-program reduction, spatial branch-and-bound construction, and conclusion of the public manuscript were read. The method guarantees successively refined outer bounds and eventual sharpness, with an explicit \(\epsilon\)-sharpness certificate when stopped early.

seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace unrestricted response-function polynomial optimization by the sixteen lifted terminal-splitting charts, eliminate their eight rank-one and four alignment equations in a fixed binary order, and isolate only univariate algebraic roots at the projection step.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for exact Markov-mixture causal bounds, disconnected ATT algorithms, and symbolic branch-aware projection found general polynomial bounding software and finite-mixture partial identification, but no exact attained algorithm for an arm-aligned Markov fiber.
adjacent_threads: Critch2013: chartwise rational inversion and membership inequalities
AhnKasahara2026: identical target and regular full-path likelihood
ChenChristensenTamer2018: criterion inversion when point identification may fail
seed_details.red_team: This is merely a small instance of general quantifier elimination or Autobounds.
seed_details.rebuttal: The deliverable forbids a black-box existence claim: it requires model-specific splitting formulas, a bounded branch tree, endpoint representations, and infeasibility certificates, and it preserves disconnected components that an interval-only routine loses.

The paper explicitly sends vanishing-denominator cases to lower-dimensional submodels rather than classifying a causal functional on them.

seed_details.destination_search: Searches for parametric semialgebraic phase diagrams of finite-mixture causal bounds found numerical sensitivity recomputation and HMM membership inequalities, but no exact probability-box topology diagram for this ATT target.

seed_details.rebuttal: The critical values are algebraic bifurcation points of the feasible fiber, and a completeness theorem for their list is additional mathematical content needed to explain endpoint and component switches.
seed_details.decision: survived Step 1 but deferred behind the combined S1--S2 kernel

seed_details.anchor_location: The full-path likelihood setup and the matrix products used in the proof of Proposition P-2 were read, together with the empirical motivation in the Introduction.
seed_details.question: Which explicit pairs, triples, and four-path cells generate exactly the same aggregate-ATT fiber as the full observed path law?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace latent-component recovery from a fixed collection of full-path matrices by comparison of fibers under candidate marginalization maps; necessity requires two full laws with the same retained marginals and different ATT images.
seed_details.destination_search: The search reached Gupta--Kumar--Vassilvitskii on three-trail recovery and Allman--Matias--Rhodes on three-block tensors, but neither studies two treatment arms, shared prehistory, or preservation of a causal functional under marginalization.
seed_details.red_team: Three-way tensor uniqueness already proves that triples are sufficient.
seed_details.rebuttal: The binary destination violates the state-count condition used by the three-trail result and requires cross-arm type alignment; moreover, ATT may be preserved even when the components are not uniquely recovered.
seed_details.decision: not advanced beyond Step 0 because the information-minimality proof is less feasible than the top three

seed_details.anchor_location: The likelihood and weighted-bootstrap sections were read after the point-identification propositions. Their information-matrix conditions place merger fibers outside the regular inferential theorem.
seed_details.question: Can a full-PMF inversion cover every component of a branch-changing ATT set uniformly, while feasible-center projection attains endpoint and Hausdorff consistency exactly on observable branch-continuity strata?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the influence-function expansion of a selected regular ATT estimate by simultaneous multinomial-law inversion followed by the complete set-valued fiber map.
seed_details.destination_search: Chen--Christensen--Tamer, Romano--Shaikh, Beresteanu--Molinari, and Fang--Santos cover general set inference or directional maps, but none supplies model-specific component persistence for a finite union of latent-transition branches.
seed_details.red_team: Uniform coverage follows immediately from a multinomial concentration inequality and has no econometric content.
seed_details.rebuttal: The concentration step is routine, but the nonempty feasible-center construction, preservation of disconnected components, and necessary branch-continuity conditions for Hausdorff recovery depend on the new fiber atlas.

seed_details.anchor_location: The Introduction, Proposition P-2, its eigenvector and relative-permutation alignment proof, and the aggregate-ATT construction in Proposition P-1 were read. Higgins--Jochmans Theorem 1 and its four-step joint-diagonalization proof were then read as the closest adjacent component-recovery thread.
seed_details.question: Is cross-arm alignment generically nonunique on a relatively open collision stratum, with the aggregate ATT image equal to a disconnected finite set even though each arm is separately identified?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: After within-arm recovery up to permutation, retain rather than resolve the relative permutation and intersect each candidate matching with the shared-pretransition constraints.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for causal consequences of relative label matching in two finite Markov mixtures found within-process ordering arguments but no ATT-image theorem across treatment arms.
seed_details.red_team: Label switching is a familiar nuisance and a two-point example is witness-trivial.
seed_details.rebuttal: A valid version would prove persistence on a named relatively open collision stratum and show that simultaneous relabeling cannot remove the relative cross-arm ambiguity; the single-law witness alone is not the claimed result.
seed_details.decision: kept as a diagnostic, not the kernel

seed_details.anchor_location: The explicit rational inverse, the vanishing-denominator discussion, the semialgebraic membership test, and the equilibrium submodel discussion in Applications were read.
seed_details.question: Can the Ahn--Kasahara spectral reconstruction be continued by rational coordinates onto every eigenvalue-collision and rank-loss stratum that still determines aggregate ATT?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace eigenvectors by label-invariant cumulant or splitting coordinates and classify which rational ATT combinations extend continuously across each denominator-zero locus.
seed_details.destination_search: The search found birational binary-HMM coordinates and generic panel mixture recovery, but no continuation result for an arm-coupled causal functional.
seed_details.red_team: Critch already supplies the needed birational continuation.
seed_details.rebuttal: Critch treats one stationary binary HMM and explicitly reduces exceptional points to submodels; it has no treatment-arm matching, shared untreated transition, or aggregate ATT functional.

seed_details.anchor_location: The Introduction, the two-component factorization, equation (3.2), the probability and monotonicity constraint construction, and the conclusion were read. Their exact set varies mixture weights under an exclusion and does not couple two Markov arms.
seed_details.question: For the common-prehistory merger law, can four convex control decompositions yield closed-form ATT endpoints and an exact critical \(\eta\) at which the sign conclusion changes?
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace the excluded-instrument weight family by the joint arm-weight inequalities induced by \(\pi_z\) and \(e_z\), then optimize affine counterfactual means over four eight-inequality polygons.
seed_details.destination_search: Searches for finite-mixture probability-box comparative statics and Markov ATT polygons found exact mixture restrictions but no common-prehistory treatment-control coupling.
seed_details.red_team: This is a hand-tuned example whose endpoints are routine linear programming.
seed_details.rebuttal: It is retained only as a destructive check and exact benchmark for the general atlas; the proposal does not elevate the special-law computation to the main novelty claim.
